annotations: "The ubuntu-latest label will migrate to Ubuntu 26 beginning October 19, 2026. For more information, see https://github.com/actions/runner-images/issues/14748"
claim_ceiling: Class-level diagnosis of an orchestration failure. It is not a claim about the provider's internal state and not an audit of any run.

mechanism.branch: lines 248-250: non-zero rc with no AUTH_RE/NETWORK_RE match -> 'OpenCode failed without transient/auth signature' -> immediate exit $rc (no retry, no model rotation)
mechanism.why_no_retry: the annotations carry no LEX_MODEL_AUTH_FAILURE, no LEX_MODEL_ROTATE, no LEX_ZERO_DELTA_REPAIR and no LEX_WORK_QUANTUM_EXPIRED, so neither the auth nor the network retry branch can match

mechanism_note: Job metadata and check-run annotations only. Logs are HTTP 403 without a GH token, so no log line, provider error or agent trace is quoted. The failing-step pattern, the empty delta and the absence of an audit ref are read from the committed job envelopes and git.
requirement_class: factory-wide requirement 20 (a provider/orchestration failure is not a verdict, not a product defect and not a human-gate problem)
